text:
Priya Rao: Heads up — NovaHealth renewal just moved to DocuSign, but procurement flagged two blockers: they need the updated SOW attached (SOW_v3.pdf) and KMS onboarding confirmation for Redwood Private. Also finance is asking to shift to net30 and reduce seats from 250→200. Can team confirm pricing/prorate and signature path? @Ben Cho @Tom Alvarez

Ben Cho: Got it. Pricing team ran a quick proration; rough credit for 50 seats = $18,750 (monthly) — will confirm official amendment. Do we keep committed term length? :thinking:

Tom Alvarez: Finance needs a PO with vendor code + tax id. If billing moves to NovaHealth EU entity we need VAT field. Also confirm whether payment method stays wire or cc.

Lena Martins: Legal — we can do an amendment + SOW attachment. Need a one-line clause for KMS onboarding SLA. Draft below, please review:

```
Amendment: Customer and Provider agree that KMS onboarding shall be completed within 30 days of execution. Failure to complete onboarding does not delay payment obligations.
```

Priya Rao: Thanks Lena. Customer is asking to delegate signature to Procurement lead (Natalie Chung). Is that acceptable? @Lena Martins

Lena Martins: Procurement delegate ok if email matches signer on PO; we'll add signer verification clause. :thumbsup: 

DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0x9f3... created by priya@redwood.ai — status: sent — recipients: priya@..., natalie@novahealth.com (needs to sign)

Ben Cho: I'll confirm the economics today and send updated order form (OF_NovaHealth_2026-03_v2.pdf). If finance ok with net30 we'll generate amendment and credit memo for 50 seats.

Tom Alvarez: @Priya please get the PO scanned and upload in this thread. Also send billing contact: billing@novahealth.com

Priya Rao: Uploaded PO (PO_55678.pdf) to the customer portal, vendor code missing — asked procurement to add NH-PRIV-01. Scheduling: onboarding enablement — @Jon Patel can you run a 45m session next Wed + a 30m Q&A? Customer wants deep-dive on KMS key rotation and audit logs.

Jon Patel: Yup, I can do Wed 10am PT. Will prepare demo: key rotation + audit export. Invite going out now. :calendar: 

Ben Cho: One more ask — customer requested an SSO kickoff before cutover. We can bundle into the enablement session.

Priya Rao: Noted. Also flagging risk: procurement lead said budget holder needs CFO sign-off if term changes from 12→9 months. That could delay signing by up to 5 business days.

Lena Martins: Add fallback: if CFO delayed, we accept exec-level signature + follow-up SOW confirmation. I'll add language to amendment.

Tom Alvarez: FYI — if net30 accepted, payment terms update will require finance ops ticket; I'll open it and cc billing@redwood.ai.

Priya Rao: Great — action items:
- Ben confirm final pricing/prorate + send OF (Ben) ✅
- Lena update amendment + signer-verification clause (Lena)
- Tom open finance ops ticket + confirm vendor code final (Tom)
- Jon schedule enablement + send invites (Jon)
- Priya follow up with Natalie for signature and confirm PO upload (Priya)
Will check back once OF attached. :rocket:

Natalie Chung: (NovaHealth) I'm the procurement lead — confirming I'll sign after CFO ok. I uploaded the PO with vendor code NH-PRIV-01 to the portal. Thanks everyone.

DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0x9f3... updated — natalie@novahealth.com signed at 2026-03-15T17:02:11Z — status: completed

Priya Rao: Signed and closed. Moving to onboarding — will raise a feedback capture form post-session. Thanks team. :tada:
